- **Knowledge brain (gbrain):** It refused my search because its connection isn't linked to the member being served. I didn't need it, since Anselm's message had the figure. To fix it, someone on the brain host can link the connection to a member with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
